in_marathi.name: Anvesh
in_marathi.long_meaning: Anvesh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Anvesh is derived from the Sanskrit word 'anu' meaning 'towards' and 'vidh' meaning 'knowledge'. It signifies a person who is always eager to gain knowledge and is intellectually curious.

vedic_reference.note: Anveshana (अन्वेषन) is the Sanskrit term for inquiry, search, investigation, or exploration. It's a process of seeking knowledge or understanding. This name is derived from the root Anu-Vesh (अनु-वेष), meaning 'searching again' or 'inquiring further'.
